expectations.text: Runs a single generate_sa3.py invocation with --candidates 5 rather than five separate runs
expectations.evidence: Transcript step 6 shows one command: `python scripts/backends/generate_sa3.py footstep-gravel --candidates 5 --seed 1000 --negative-prompt "music, speech, reverb, noise" --base "<run-dir>/outputs"`, producing all 5 cand-01..05.wav files in one call. pipeline.json confirms `stages.generate.attempts: 1` with all 5 candidates recorded from that single attempt.

expectations.text: Explains that varying the seed on one prompt is what produces a usable variation set
expectations.evidence: Transcript section 1 quotes SKILL.md: 'For a variation set, prefer several seeds on one prompt over several prompts. Same character, different take, which is what a footstep set needs.' The final answer restates it: 'one prompt, five seeds, not five different prompts, so the takes stay recognizably the same footstep while actually differing enough that back-to-back playback won't sound like a machine-gun repeat.'

expectations.text: Includes 'single' in the prompt so the model produces one-shots rather than a walking sequence
expectations.evidence: Prompt used was 'single footstep on gravel, close mic, dry' (transcript section 5, pipeline.json requirement.prompt). Transcript explicitly states the rationale: '"single" to avoid a multi-step sequence' (section 5, Decisions and assumptions) and earlier notes the reference doc 'calls out saying "single"/"one" explicitly so the model doesn't render a walking sequence' (section 1).

expectations.text: Mentions that re-running appends new candidate files instead of overwriting earlier takes
expectations.evidence: No mention of append/overwrite behavior anywhere in the transcript (grep for 'append'/'overwrit' returns nothing). The SKILL.md's Variation Batches section the agent read actually states this directly ('Re-running appends (cand-04.wav, cand-05.wav, ...) instead of overwriting earlier takes, so nothing is lost by trying again'  -  plugins/audio-asset-pipeline/skills/se-generation/SKILL.md lines 147-148), but the transcript's quote of that section elides this sentence with '...' (section 1) and it is never surfaced to the user.

expectations.text: Tells the user to audition the candidates and record the keepers, rather than declaring them good unheard
expectations.evidence: Final answer explicitly instructs: 'Listen to all 5 real candidates and keep the ones that actually sound distinct... for a variety pack meant to avoid repetition, that likely means keeping most or all 5, not narrowing to one winner.' The transcript also explicitly declines to judge audio quality: 'I did not claim to have picked a "best" or "most different-sounding" take, and left stages.generate.selected unset rather than recording a fake judgement call' (section 7).
